blocks.text: To the gentle rhythm of a gong, a Tausug man bearing the Sulu Sultanate flag entered a Zamboanga City hotel ballroom on Monday, signaling the start of an enthronement ceremony for a new crown prince of the Sultanate of Sulu and North Borneo. The Punjungan family – largely dormant since orchestrating the 2013 Lahad Datu intrusion – is attempting a resurgence. Their vehicle: the elevation of Datu Alianapia Kiram, 73, as Raja Muda (crown prince, or Ladja Murah in Tausug).
